platforms.name: Android Phone
platforms.noteAr: ملفات تثبيت التلفزيون تُنزّل من الموقع عند الطلب، مع التحقق من سلامتها. حجم الموبايل أقل بنحو النصف.
platforms.noteEn: TV installers download on demand from the website with integrity verification; phone APK approximately half its previous size.

platforms.name: Android TV / Google TV
platforms.noteAr: قوائم وإعدادات وخطوط موحّدة، مع الحفاظ على توافق النظام.
platforms.noteEn: Shared menus, settings and typography, preserving platform compatibility.
platforms.validation: Packaged grouping/resume and theme/settings layout passed at 720p and 1080p; physical TV review pending.

platforms.name: Amazon Fire TV · Fire OS
platforms.noteAr: قوائم وإعدادات وخطوط موحّدة، مع الحفاظ على توافق النظام.
platforms.noteEn: Shared menus, settings and typography, preserving platform compatibility.
platforms.validation: Packaged grouping/resume and theme/settings layout passed at 720p and 1080p; physical TV review pending.

platforms.name: Samsung · Tizen
platforms.noteAr: قوائم وإعدادات وخطوط موحّدة، مع الحفاظ على توافق النظام.
platforms.noteEn: Tizen 2/3/4/5 packages updated; older engines use compatibility transforms. The separate Lite 2 package has a simpler no-animation shell. Physical legacy TV verification remains pending.
platforms.validation: Tizen 4/5 packaged grouping and settings checked; Chromium63 theme scrolling passed. Tizen 2/3 stay on 1.1.347; physical TV review pending.

platforms.name: LG · webOS
platforms.noteAr: نسخة محدثة بالواجهة النهائية والتخفيف وإصلاح بيانات IPTV والريموت. تتطلب Developer Mode؛ الاختبار على شاشة LG فعلية ما زال مطلوبًا.
platforms.noteEn: Updated reviewed frontend, lightweight default, IPTV provider transport and remote controls. Developer Mode required; physical LG review pending.
platforms.validation: Packaged Home 1080p/720p/540p bounds checked; settings/theme scrolling, provider catalog, category arrows, shared player Up/Down, Plus QR and series grouping passed. Physical TV review pending.

platforms.name: Android 4.4 Legacy
platforms.noteEn: Android 4.4+: reduced native M3U engine; no Xtream, EPG or modern UI.
platforms.noteAr: أندرويد 4.4+: محرك M3U أصلي مخفف؛ لا يشمل Xtream أو EPG أو الواجهة الحديثة.

releases.name: Morph Launcher Lite 2
releases.noteEn: Separate simple ES5 shell for Tizen 2; launches installed apps.
